decisions.reason: The data format plug-in line has its own page, builds directly on the established offer and costs little to maintain, so the option stays open while demand evidence accumulates.

The building digital twin service is still only mentioned and its value remains uncertain, but holding this low-cost option in an emerging field for another year is cheaper than abandoning it prematurely.
The open GIS framework underpins the firm's component and standards strategy, giving it high strategic option value at low marginal cost.

The identity service for GIS applications was actively announced and fills the integration need left after dropping the authentication delegation service, so it is worth keeping despite some overlap risk.
The newly launched consulting workshop has its own page, uses existing consulting staff at little extra cost and is too new for its value to be judged.
